name: Low Country Case & Millwork
old_description: At Low Country Case and Millwork, we understand that spaces are more than just physical dimensions – they are canvases waiting to be transformed into unique experiences. As quality craftsman, we specialize in crafting high end designs that breathe life into offices, breweries, hotels, and more turning the customer’s vision into a reality.
about:
Low Country Case & Millwork was founded in 1990 in Ladson, South Carolina, as a family-owned and operated business. The company traces its start to a veterinary clinic project in Summerville for Trident Construction, which remains its largest client. Current CEO David Stasiukaitis is the son of the founder.

The firm provides turnkey architectural millwork and custom cabinetry, handling design, manufacturing, finishing, and installation from its 52,000-square-foot facility. The plant houses four divisions—cabinetry, millwork, finishing, and climate-controlled shipping—and is equipped with CNC machines and Cabinet Vision CAD software. A team of over 60 craftsmen produces plastic laminate cabinets, solid surface counters, wall panels, and high-end woodwork.

The company serves hospitality, medical, office, education, institutional, corporate, and industrial sectors. Notable projects include the Charleston Visitor Center, Hotel Bennett, Firefly Distillery, Sanctuary Chapel at Kiawah, and Roper Medical Office. Trident Construction is cited as a long-standing major client.

Low Country Case & Millwork differentiates itself by controlling quality from drawing through installation, maintaining AWI membership, and emphasizing a “damn good product” philosophy. The founder’s original niche in commercial cabinetry and millwork underpins its turnkey approach.

name: Loyal Stricklin
old_description: The brand was founded in April 2014 while Michael was in graduate school for design and construction at Auburn University. What began as a creative outlet—and a way to earn extra money during school—quickly grew into a full-time endeavor by August of that same year.
about:
Loyal Stricklin was founded in April 2014 in Nashville, Tennessee, by Michael Stricklin while he was completing graduate studies in design and construction at Auburn University. What began as a creative outlet and a way to earn extra money during school became a full-time operation by August of that same year. The company remains owned and operated by Stricklin, who works on the production floor daily alongside a small team of craftsmen and women.

The brand produces high-end outerwear, pants, and leather goods, including denim jeans, waxed canvas jackets, and leather accessories. All cutting, sewing, and assembly labor is performed in the United States, with the majority of goods made to order in the company's Nashville workshop. Additional production capacity comes from a network of partner sewing shops in California and Texas. Materials are sourced from Japanese and Italian mills as well as American suppliers such as Horween Leather.

Loyal Stricklin sells directly to consumers seeking durable, American-made workwear and leather goods, serving denim enthusiasts and customers who value garments that improve with age. The company also offers made-to-order clothing with a typical lead time of four to six weeks.

Stricklin emphasizes uncompromising material quality and domestic manufacturing as the foundation of the brand. The company states that its products are built to endure real use, developing character over time, and points to over 11 years in business as evidence of its commitment to lasting craftsmanship.

Since its founding in 1961, Loyd's Electric Supply, Inc. has been headquartered in Springfield, Missouri, serving the Ozarks region across Southwest Missouri and Northwest Arkansas. The company operates as an electrical wholesale distributor, supplying contractors and industrial buyers with a broad range of electrical materials.

The distributor stocks wire, gear and circuit breakers, light bulbs, lighting fixtures, wiring devices, conduit, and tools, maintaining inventory for immediate pickup or delivery. A company-owned fleet of trucks transports orders to job sites throughout the service territory, while an experienced sales force assists with product selection and project coordination.

Customers span electrical contracting firms, commercial and residential builders, industrial maintenance teams, and municipal facilities in the Ozarks. The product offering supports new construction, renovation, and ongoing maintenance and repair operations across those sectors.

The company highlights its six-decade regional presence, extensive in-stock inventory, and dedicated delivery fleet as factors that distinguish it from broader-line distributors. By combining local stock depth with rapid delivery, Loyd's Electric Supply aims to minimize downtime for contractors on time-sensitive projects.

name: Lyle W Williams
old_description: The Lyle W. Williams team specializes in selling and servicing electrical products for distributors, contractors, engineers, and other end users. We’re a collaborative team with experience in the most demanding electrical market segments.
about:
Lyle W. Williams Company operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it was founded in 1976. The firm began as a manufacturer's representative agency focused on electrical products, building relationships across the Intermountain and Pacific Northwest regions.

The company represents more than 35 electrical manufacturers, providing full-spectrum support that includes strategic sales and territory management, on-site technical training and certification, warehouse and logistics optimization, and specification and project support. A team of outside sales professionals covers eight territories — Alaska, Eastern Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Utah, Washington, and Western Wyoming — while an inside sales group handles day-to-day coordination from the Salt Lake City headquarters.

Lyle W. Williams serves distributors, contractors, engineers, and end users in residential, commercial, industrial, utility, and data-center markets. Its product lines span energy and renewable energy, telecommunications, data communications, and general electrical construction, connecting manufacturers with customers throughout the Mountain West and Northwest.

The firm emphasizes a solution-based sales process, deep product knowledge, and long-term relationships grounded in integrity, respect, and excellence — values it has maintained for over 50 years in the trade.

name: M & P Auto Parts
old_description: We have been serving the Auburn community since 1977 with the finest new and used car parts, ensuring absolute customer satisfaction. Our professional team offers years of experience and will help you find the right component to suit your needs. We carry a variety of used car parts, accessories and tools for foreign and domestic autos with exceptional value and service – all with the goal of being the top source for auto parts in the Auburn area.
about:
Founded in 1977 in Auburn, Maine, M & P Auto Parts has spent decades serving the region from its facility on Merrow Road. The business began as a local auto parts supplier and grew into a full-service salvage yard that purchases, dismantles, and resells functional components from both working and nonworking vehicles.

The company operates a salvage yard that stocks new and used auto parts for foreign and domestic cars and trucks, including items such as air pumps, carburetors, fenders, headlights, rear doors, and trunk lids. It also provides junk car removal — available only in the Auburn and Lewiston areas — and offers an online multi-part search tool for customers to locate inventory. A 90-day warranty covers mechanical parts, while electrical parts carry a 30-day warranty.

M & P Auto Parts serves individual vehicle owners, repair shops, and classic-car enthusiasts across a wide swath of central and southern Maine. Its service area includes Auburn, Lewiston, Portland, Augusta, Waterville, Brunswick, Sanford, Scarborough, Biddeford, Bangor, and surrounding communities. The yard caters to those needing affordable replacement parts for everything from daily drivers to rare classic vehicles.

Membership in the Maine Auto Recyclers Association certifies the operation to perform junk car removal to state standards, and the company emphasizes community relationships and positive customer interactions as core to its approach.

about:
M & S Fabricators operates from Lorton, Virginia, where it was founded in 2001. The company provides customized sheet metal fabrication services to contractors in the surrounding area.

M & S Fabricators serves residential and commercial contractors, supplying fabricated ductwork and accessories for HVAC installations in both single-family homes and commercial buildings. Its customer base includes local contractors who rely on the shop for custom fittings and duct components.

The company emphasizes craftsmanship and efficiency, stating that its experienced professionals understand the complex details behind every project and are committed to surpassing client expectations on every job.

name: M&I Electric Industries
old_description: Texas-based manufacturer, part of the Myers Power Products group, producing custom medium- and low-voltage switchgear and power distribution equipment for oil and gas, marine, and power generation customers
about:
M&I Electric, LLC operates from Beaumont, Texas, where it was established in 1946. The company functions as part of the Myers Power Products group, a collection of businesses that manufacture engineered-to-order and standard medium- and low-voltage power distribution equipment for public and private sector customers. Over seven decades, the business has grown from its founding into a supplier of custom power delivery solutions for the global energy industry.

The company designs and builds custom medium- and low-voltage switchgear, arc-resistant switchgear, bus duct systems, motor control centers, AC and DC drives, power distribution centers, and automation control systems. Its capabilities include in-house engineering, custom manufacturing, and a quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015. In addition to equipment production, M&I Electric provides technical field services such as acceptance testing, startup services, high- and low-voltage testing, generator testing, preventative maintenance, repair, and substation and power delivery testing.

M&I Electric serves the oil and gas sector across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations, as well as power generation and distribution, marine, and general industrial markets. Customers include energy companies that require engineered power distribution equipment for demanding industrial and marine applications worldwide.

The company emphasizes a collaborative, customer-driven approach: client input shapes product design at key milestones, and its processes aim to deliver unique solutions in a uniform, repeatable manner. This focus on tailoring equipment to specific requirements, combined with lifelong support and post-warranty service, is presented as the core differentiator.

old_description: With a multitude of welding and assembly processes we can take on jobs, large and small.  Our 30 Ton capacity facility offers Mig and Tig welding, that includes various grades of steel, stainless steel and aluminum.
about:
M-C Fabrication Inc operates from Olathe, Kansas, on the southwest side of the Kansas City metropolitan area. The company was founded in 1976 as a millwright and conveyor fabricator, and has since grown into a fully integrated metal fabrication shop.

The 100,000-square-foot facility on more than eight acres houses a range of capabilities including MIG and TIG welding, custom metal sawing with automated bandsaws and a NISHIJMAX cold cut saw, press brake forming and rolling on two Amada brakes, hi-def plasma cutting on plates up to 8 by 14 feet, precision laser cutting with dual interchangeable tables, CNC machining on six vertical mills and horizontal lathes, iron working, and finishing services such as wet painting, powder coating, zinc plating, and galvanizing. The shop employs 37 certified welders and two on-site programmers, and handles material from 20-gauge sheet metal up to 2-inch plate.

M-C Fabrication serves customers globally, producing heavy components, large weldments, and small assemblies used around the world. While the company does not list specific industry sectors, its focus on heavy fabrication suggests clients in industrial equipment, structural steel, and machinery manufacturing.

The company emphasizes its integrated in-house capacity—from design and programming through cutting, forming, machining, welding, and finishing—as a differentiator that allows it to tackle large, complex jobs with an average lead time of four to six weeks.

old_description: MAHLE is a leading international development partner and supplier to the automotive industry with customers in both passenger car and commercial vehicle sectors. Founded in 1920, the technology group is working on the climate-neutral mobility of tomorrow, with a focus on the strategic areas of electrification and thermal management as well as further technologies to reduce CO
about:
MAHLE Engine Components USA, Inc. is headquartered in Russellville, Arkansas. The global MAHLE Group was founded in 1920 and has grown into a major automotive supplier. The U.S. entity operates as part of this international technology group.

The company develops and manufactures components for internal combustion engines, electric powertrains, and thermal management systems. Its product portfolio includes e-motors such as the SCT E-Motor, the X20 e-bike drive system, range extenders for electric trucks, and the chargeBIG charging network. Globally, MAHLE employs 64,242 people across 127 production locations and 11 R&D centers, generating 11.3 billion EUR in annual sales.

MAHLE serves the passenger car and commercial vehicle sectors, supplying original equipment manufacturers as well as the aftermarket through its Lifecycle and Mobility division, which provides spare parts and services to trade partners, workshops, and engine repair shops. The company also addresses the e-mobility market, including e-bikes and heavy-duty electric trucks.

MAHLE positions itself as a partner for climate-neutral mobility, focusing on electrification, thermal management, and low-emission combustion technologies that can run on renewable fuels such as hydrogen. The company notes that one in every two vehicles worldwide is equipped with MAHLE components.
